content.short: Radom enables recurring and one-time, permission-less, on-chain payments for online subscriptions and products.
content.description: Subscription businesses have long faced barriers to serving crypto users because recurring on-chain payments were not available. Radom enables merchants worldwide to onboard onto a decentralized application using any non-custodial wallet and to craft products equipped with embedded checkouts and payment links that accept cryptocurrency, tokens, and stablecoins. This setup lets customers complete purchases with their own non-custodial wallets, while Radom charges a modest 0.5% transaction fee.
content.meta: Radom enables recurring and on-chain payments for online subscriptions and products. Discover Radom and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
